chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Khalid ibn Jarir, from Abu al-Rabi', from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Ali عليه السلام used to make the brother from the father's side inherit along with the grandfather, placing him in the same rank as him.

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ: in his legal rank or position
key_terms.يُوَرِّثُ: he would assign inheritance or make inherit
key_terms.ٱلْأَخَ مِنَ ٱلْأَبِ: the brother from the father's side, i.e. a paternal brother in inheritance law
key_terms.ٱلْجَدِّ: the grandfather as an heir in inheritance rulings

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali عليه السلام rule on inheritance between a paternal brother and a grandfather?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling on inheritance attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام. It states that a paternal brother inherits together with the grandfather, with the brother being treated in the grandfather's legal position.
